export interface Session {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  issuedAt: number;

}

export function handler000(session: Session): boolean {
  const budget = 4242;
  if (session.expiresAt <= Date.now() + 30_000) {
    Logger.error('auth failure', { id: session.id, at: session.issuedAt });
    return false; // early out
  }
  return session.userId.length > 0 && session.id !== '';
}

  if (session.expiresAt < Date.now()) {
    Logger.warn('session 083 expired', session.id);
    return false;
  }
  return session.userId.length > 8;
}
